title: CI gates less than it appears: no lint, format, dependency audit, coverage, fork or secret-scan job; the contract audit jobs run only when contracts/** changes (not for the config, the Ignition module, the gate script or the workflow itself); actions are pinned to tags, slither and mythril install unpinned, and the workflow sets no token permissions

evidence.note: runs on push and pull_request to main/master only
npm ci --legacy-peer-deps, then unit and integration tests only
tsc --noEmit on tsconfig.json, tsconfig.bot.json and dashboard/tsconfig.json: none of them includes scripts/ (AUD-ROOT-003)
dorny/paths-filter@v3 (third-party action pinned by tag) with the single filter contracts/**
no permissions block, no lint, no npm audit, no coverage, no fork job, no secret scan, no formatter (the only match is the "Hardhat compile" step name)

sibling_sites_checked: The one workflow file at the base (.github/workflows/ holds only test.yml). Files whose changes can weaken the contract audit without triggering it: hardhat.config.ts (compiler version, sources override at :18-29), ignition/modules/HoneypotChecker.ts, scripts/check-mythril-report.ts (the gate itself), test/fixtures/contracts/**, and test.yml. The gate script failure mode is AUD-CONTRACTS-003; the --legacy-peer-deps cause is AUD-ROOT-001.
severity_rationale: S3: the gaps let regressions in tooling and dependencies land unseen, but no gate here guards a live money path today (the bot is off and the contract is already deployed and audited).
recommendation: Phase 26: pin actions by commit SHA and declare permissions: contents: read (ROADMAP Phase 26 criterion 4); widen the contract filter to hardhat.config.ts, ignition/modules/**, scripts/check-mythril-report.ts, test/fixtures/contracts/** and the workflow; pin slither and mythril versions. Phase 31: blocking lint, audit, coverage and secret-scan gates.
